name: Straight-bar Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip overhand.
Stand close enough for the cable to pull mostly upward, with elbows near the ribs.
Extend the elbows to press the bar down.
Return slowly without letting the upper arms swing forward.
mistakes: Leaning body weight onto the bar.
Letting elbows flare or drift with every rep.
breathing: Exhale as you push down; inhale as you return.
